reply_text: नमस्ते, मैं ज़ेंट्रोमार्ट का एआई सहायता सहायक हूँ। हाँ, केस्ट्रेल के7 स्मार्टफोन (SKU ELE-0012) ज़ेंट्रोमार्ट अश्योर्ड है। आप ऐप में 'My Orders' सेक्शन में जाकर क्लेम कर सकते हैं, जिसके बाद ज़ेंट्रोमार्ट पिकअप और मरम्मत या बदलने का इंतज़ाम करेगा।

chunks_used.title: ZentroMart Assured
chunks_used.text: Products marked `assured = true` in the catalog carry a 12-month ZentroMart Assured warranty from the delivery date, in addition to any brand warranty. Claims are raised in the app under My Orders, and ZentroMart arranges pickup and repair or replacement.

chunks_used.title: Opening
chunks_used.text: Introduce yourself as ZentroMart's AI support assistant in your first reply.

chunks_used.title: Voice replies
chunks_used.text: When replying by voice, keep it to two or three short sentences. Say dates with the month name ("the 24th of October"), read order IDs in groups of four digits, and say amounts in rupees ("forty-nine rupees").

chunks_used.title: Language
chunks_used.text: Reply in the language the customer uses. If the customer switches language, switch with them.

chunks_retrieved.title: Brand warranty
chunks_retrieved.text: Most electronics come with the manufacturer's warranty. The warranty period is listed in the `warranty_months` column of the product catalog. Brand warranty claims are made with the manufacturer's service centre.

chunks_retrieved.title: ZentroMart Assured
chunks_retrieved.text: Products marked `assured = true` in the catalog carry a 12-month ZentroMart Assured warranty from the delivery date, in addition to any brand warranty. Claims are raised in the app under My Orders, and ZentroMart arranges pickup and repair or replacement.

chunks_retrieved.title: Refund reference number
chunks_retrieved.text: Every initiated refund has a refund reference number (RRN) that the customer's bank can trace. Share it when a customer says the money has not arrived.

chunks_retrieved.title: Warranty
chunks_retrieved.text: ZentroMart Assured never applies to marketplace seller items, even if the listing says assured. Seller items carry only the brand warranty.

chunks_retrieved.title: ZentroMart Plus में क्या मिलता है?
chunks_retrieved.text: मुफ़्त एक्सप्रेस डिलीवरी, किसी भी रिटर्न पर पिकअप फ़ीस नहीं, और रिटर्न का रिफ़ंड पिकअप के समय ही शुरू हो जाता है।

chunks_retrieved.title: खराब या गलत सामान आया तो क्या करें?
chunks_retrieved.text: डिलीवरी के 48 घंटे के अंदर सामान और पैकेट की फ़ोटो के साथ शिकायत करें। जाँच के बाद मुफ़्त रिप्लेसमेंट या पूरा रिफ़ंड मिलेगा।

chunks_retrieved.title: Smartwatch not syncing
chunks_retrieved.text:
1. Make sure the companion app has Bluetooth and location permission.
2. Restart the watch and the phone.
3. Unpair the watch in the app and pair it again.

chunks_retrieved.title: Phone charging slowly
chunks_retrieved.text:
1. Use the original cable and adapter.
2. Clean the charging port gently with a dry, soft brush.
3. Turn on airplane mode while charging to check whether background apps are the cause.
